markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with model agreement [F1] and suggested tumor at all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% (ECE 5%) | Near-certain invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Invasive (90% target, 90% test) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64th percentile [F6] | Typical despite JPEG degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (82%–90%) [F5] | Unanimous reference neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Strongest driver (+1.79, z=1.48); distinguishes from InSitu BACH_0165 [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 7, 9) · context · High score (z=1.50, -1.06); descriptive, 8/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.91, z=1.54) [F4], 0/20 spot-check is unreliable · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (z=-0.59) favors invasive (+0.70); 20/20 spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) vs random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Frozen-section and severity-3 JPEG artifacts mimic invasion over InSitu (contrast case BACH_0165, 78% similarity).
- Dense lymphocytes (regions 4, 7, 9) obscure ducts while cell segmentation is disabled and mitoses are unreliable.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Confirm stromal invasion vs InSitu; stains are blocked on simulated frozen sections.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 4**: Manually verify mitoses and pleomorphism; mitotic concept score is unreliable (0/20).
3. **Regions 0–4, 7, 8–11**: Verify tumor at all four margins (430–753 um) and region 7 (66% risk).
